market.title: Bronny James' Next Team
resolutionNote: Resolves to whichever team Bronny James is officially on before Oct 23, 2026 - if he retires without joining a new team, the 'Retires / No Team' outcome resolves Yes instead.
Kalshi's own wording: "If Bronny James's next team is Los Angeles before Oct 23, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes."

No genuinely matching Polymarket market exists - Polymarket only lists a separate 'Will LeBron and Bronny play together in 2026-27?' market, a different question from which specific team Bronny ends up on, so this page is Kalshi-only.

text: LeBron James ended his eight-year run with the Lakers on June 30, 2026, signing a two-year, $8M deal with the Philadelphia 76ers - the same free agency already tracked on this site's LeBron James market page. Bronny, his son, stayed behind on a fully guaranteed contract.

That's fueled persistent speculation about a father-son reunion, with multiple reported trade frameworks that would send Bronny to Philadelphia for a second-round pick or a young wing. But Rich Paul, who represents both James men, has said they 'are not a package deal' and that there's no current plan for Bronny to join his father there.
Kalshi's market leans the same way: the Lakers are the heavy favorite to keep Bronny, with Philadelphia a distant but real second option and every other team barely registering.

It's not the only Bronny bet on Kalshi either - traders can also wager on which conference he ends up in, whether his next contract clears $12.5M, and even who breaks the news of his eventual landing spot: Bronny himself, his agent, a reporter like Shams Charania, or a family member.
